AdaNAG: Original Algorithm 1 with exact theoretical r0/coefficients; no G12 near-zero keep-step heuristic.
AQNPE: Original recurrence with supplied L1 for concrete problems; labelled online-scale extension on CUTEst.
timing: One observation; all FG history timestamps from that run; JIT/object construction/endpoint checks excluded; every FG checks the soft time budget.
changes_from_historical_specific: Native FG for every method; one run replaces full warm solve, three timings and separate trace; time check each FG instead of every 64.
failures: Retain all outcomes; profile failures receive infinite cost; no tuned reruns.
